title: Diagnosis
description: Why something misbehaves, backed by evidence, and the smallest fix.

reproduction.description: Steps or a command that reproduce it; empty if you could not reproduce.

hypotheses.description: Every explanation considered, including the ones ruled out.

evidence.description: path:line, command output or log line that decided it.

root_cause.description: Present only when one hypothesis is confirmed.

evidence.description: path:line references along the failing path.

fix.description: The smallest change that removes the root cause.

risk.description: What else the fix could affect.
